question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount`, with legacy root config as the implicit default and named accounts requiring explicit identity and webhook ports?
rationale: This PR is not blocked by a concrete code defect; it defines a new public Teams plugin configuration and persisted auth/session routing contract that needs owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept the account-map contract
options.body: Merge after normal exact-head gates if Teams owners agree this is the supported public contract for multi-account Teams gateways.

options.title: Revise compatibility semantics first
options.body: Ask for changes if root/default/named-account inheritance, listener-port requirements, or state scoping should differ before the contract ships.

options.title: Pause for broader account API design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a cross-channel account abstraction before Teams exposes its own public multi-account surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the account-map contract
recommendation.body: Merge after normal exact-head gates if Teams owners agree this is the supported public contract for multi-account Teams gateways.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux was explicitly requested for Microsoft-area review and has adjacent Teams config/runtime history relevant to the product contract.
